data.name: Aaisha
data.gender_notes: Aaisha is used as a female name.
data.long_meaning: Aaisha (عائشة) is a transliteration of ʿĀ'ishah, the feminine active participle of the Arabic verb ʿāsha, 'to live', so it means 'living, alive, prosperous'. It is the name of ʿĀ'ishah, a wife of the Prophet Muhammad and a major narrator of hadith, which is why the name is widely used across the Muslim world.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name carries the sense of a living, thriving person; any spiritual reading placed on it is interpretive and labelled as such.
data.etymology: Feminine participle of Arabic ʿāsha, 'to live' — 'she who lives'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaisha total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What does the name Aaisha mean?
What is the origin of the name Aaisha?
What language does the name Aaisha come from?
faq.a: Aaisha is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto.

faq.q: Is Aaisha a boy's name or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aaisha is used as a female name.

faq.q: How is Aaisha written in Arabic and Urdu?
faq.a: Aaisha is written عائشة in Arabic and عائشہ in Urdu, and आइशा in Devanagari.

faq.q: What is the linguistic root of Aaisha?
faq.a: The root of Aaisha is ع-ي-ش (ʿ-y-sh), from ʿĀ'ishah (عائشة).

faq.q: What is the etymology of Aaisha?
faq.a: Feminine participle of Arabic ʿāsha, 'to live' — 'she who lives'.

faq.q: Does Aaisha appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: Not itself a Qur'anic name; from the root ʿ-y-sh, 'to live'.
ʿĀ'ishah was a wife of the Prophet Muhammad and one of the most important narrators of hadith; she is a central figure in early Islamic history.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Aaisha?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaisha total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Aaisha?
faq.a: Aaisha appears with variants and alternative spellings such as Aaishaht, Aisha, Ayesha.

faq.q: Which names are related to Aaisha?
faq.a: Names sharing form or root with Aaisha include Aaishaht, Aaidah.
Yes. ʿĀ'ishah is the feminine participle of the Arabic verb ʿāsha, 'to live', so it means 'living, alive'.

faq.q: Where is the name Aaisha used today?
faq.a: Aaisha is used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian, Pashto naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it, so no popularity score is asserted.
